verifies.G124-C1: an entity whose attributes carry @JdbcTypeCode, @Type, @JavaType, @JdbcType, @TimeZoneStorage and @TimeZoneColumn is read instead of being skipped: each such column is asked for its target SQL type (six type prompts, answered once each) and the answered types appear in the migration. @JdbcTypeRegistration and @JavaTypeRegistration are declared on a separate registration class in the project and only checked in the sense that a project holding them is still scanned and migrated; they are class-level registrations that change no column of this entity and nothing about their effect is verified. The extra offset column that @TimeZoneColumn/@TimeZoneStorage(COLUMN) give Hibernate is NOT generated and not checked; the documentation only says 'supported', so only column-level asking is verified.
